verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own CLI covers the plan-and-approve core: `tofu plan` previews infrastructure changes, speculative plans support review before submission, and `-out=FILE` saves a plan that `tofu apply` later executes, so an approved diff can be applied exactly as reviewed. The pack does not show headless/non-interactive operation or any agent-oriented support, so the agent-driven part of the story is only implied by the existence of a documented CLI. missing for 10: documented non-interactive/automation flags, machine-readable (JSON) plan output for agents to parse and present, agent-oriented docs (no llms.txt or markdown docs), hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven plan workflows
